claim: QuotaSettings are the quotas configured for a usage plan: the limit is the target maximum number of requests that can be made in a given time period, and the period, the time period in which the limit applies, can be DAY, WEEK or MONTH.

qualifiers.scope: usage plans, QuotaSettings (API Gateway V1 API)

evidence.quote: Quotas configured for a usage plan.
The target maximum number of requests that can be made in a given time period.
The time period in which the limit applies. Valid values are "DAY", "WEEK" or "MONTH".

note: The best-effort nature of usage plan quotas is carried by api-gateway-usage-plan-not-hard-limits-use-budgets-waf (adjudicate-33 removed the unquoted condition).
